info.title: Mueblería Iván API
info.description: API para catálogo, cotizaciones, pedidos y producción de Mueblería Iván.

get.summary: Comprobar el estado de la API

get.description:
Return the authenticated user's public profile fields.

All fields are loaded by get_current_user in a single DB query so this
handler requires no additional database access.

post.summary: Obtener firma de carga a Cloudinary

post.description:
Run Hill Climbing on a selection of active orders.

Request body: {"orderIds": [...], "weights": {"delayDays": 10, ...}}
Returns: initial sequence, optimised sequence, score improvement, iterations,
stop reason, and execution time.

Run A* route optimisation for a set of pending deliveries.

Request body: {"deliveryIds": [...]}
Returns: initial route, optimised route, total distance, nodes explored,
execution time, and improvement vs. baseline.

get.description:
Return real-time KPIs from PostgreSQL.

Includes: active orders by status, revenue this month, overdue orders,
top products, average production days, payment recovery rate.
All values computed from app schema — no hardcoded numbers.

get.summary: Versiones y métricas de modelos ML
get.description:
Return all model versions with their metrics and activation status.

Metrics are stored in app.model_versions.metrics (JSON) — never hardcoded.
